objective: Run the official OpenFOAM SA tutorial unchanged, test the documented NASA NACA 0012 reconstruction, then isolate stock SST, exact NASA SSTm, and compressibility with explicit gates.

gates.name: unchanged packaged OpenFOAM v2512 airFoil2D tutorial
gates.result: Solver-reported convergence at iteration 308 with every upstream input hash unchanged.
gates.reason: The packaged case has 10720 cells, 78 wall faces, alpha 8.002 degrees, speed 26.0032 m/s, nu 1e-5 m2/s, and no forceCoeffs object; it is not the documented NASA alpha-zero case.

gates.name: stock OpenFOAM kOmegaSST
gates.remediation: Change only k and omega convection from bounded linearUpwind to bounded upwind, then restart from the original SA U and p fields.
gates.confounding_note: The accepted stock-SST value is conditional on the separately declared turbulence-convection remediation, so the SA-to-stock delta is not a pure turbulence-model-only effect.

interpretation.stock_sst: A stable, symmetric stock-SST branch can agree with the CFL3D SST force value, but only after an explicit turbulence-convection remediation; the initial pure model-only branch failed numerical entry.
interpretation.exact_sstm: On the accepted upwind branch, exact NASA SSTm reduces Cd by 0.00002296, or 0.282 percent, relative to stock SST.
interpretation.compressibility: At matched Mach, Reynolds number, velocity, mesh, turbulence equations, and force normalization, rhoSimpleFoam changes Cd by only +0.000000745, or +0.0092 percent; compressibility is negligible for this alpha-zero comparison.
interpretation.validation: Agreement of the downstream diagnostic values does not repair the failed SA reproduction, prove the undocumented official setup, or validate rocket aerodynamics.
